name: What is the final walk-through inspection, and why is it important in pre-construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the final walk-through inspection, and why is it important in pre-construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The final walk-through inspection, or 'blue tape' walk-through, is your opportunity to inspect the completed home before closing and identify any unfinished items, defects, or issues that need correction by the builder. It's crucial because it's typically your last chance to have the builder address problems before you take possession. You'll use blue tape to mark deficiencies, ensuring they are documented for repair. This process clarity helps protect your interests, especially with the intricate details of new construction in high-demand areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: The final walk-through allows you to inspect the completed pre-construction home for defects before closing, ensuring the builder addresses issues.
